title: Piso en venta en Calle del Lago Constanza, Pueblo Nuevo, Madrid Capital | fotocasa

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. The listing is 350.000 € (489.1 ZEC) and the page also carries a 1.198 € figure and comparables up to 501.281 € — nearly three orders of magnitude. Spanish dot-grouping is read correctly throughout (1.198 € is 1,198 euros, not 1.198), so this is magnitude span and not a separator misread. Note the fixable half, which is not span: in the comparables column 97.82 ZEC and 179.0 ZEC differ in decimals only because the four-significant-figure cap is applied per amount instead of to the page grid, and both would read fine at one decimal. That is the digitalocean-pricing defect showing through on a page whose wider span keeps this entry honest regardless.
